name: foundation
question: Which reactive foundation implements the LuauUI core contract? (design §3, §17 Phase 0)
context: Three candidates behind the identical public contract (src/core/contract.luau) ran the identical 26-check conformance suite (artifacts/conformance-<core>.json) and 12 bench scenarios (artifacts/bench.json). Selection rules from the design: custom if it materially wins; Fusion if it conforms better; imperative if reactivity complexity is unjustified.

candidates.summary: Minimal custom transactional push-pull core (src/core/custom.luau, ~380 lines, zero dependencies).

evidence.deterministic-behavior: synchronous flush, no external scheduler; suite deterministic across runs
evidence.allocations: heap deltas smallest-or-comparable across scenarios (headless trend only)
evidence.source-maintenance-complexity: ~380 owned lines, no vendor pin to track
evidence.diagnostics: cycle path, write-during-memo, feedback cap, quarantine all queryable via lastError()
evidence.public-api-fit: implements the contract natively incl. transactions and custom equality

candidates.summary: Thin adapter over vendored Fusion 0.3 state subset (src/core/fusion_adapter.luau + vendor/Fusion).

evidence.semantic-correctness: 19/26: no transaction batching, no per-signal equality, write-during-memo silent, revert-fires, error surfacing opaque (artifacts/conformance-fusion.json)
evidence.lifecycle-safety: scope + churn checks pass via per-resource fusion scopes
evidence.deterministic-behavior: external-scheduler dependent; observer delivery needs provider stepping
evidence.source-maintenance-complexity: 3k+ vendored lines + require transform + upstream 0.3 pin
evidence.diagnostics: errors routed to external logger, not queryable; cycle check produced no observable diagnostic
evidence.public-api-fit: contract's transaction()/eq params accepted but semantically inert

candidates.summary: Retained imperative recompute-all baseline (src/core/imperative.luau), the pattern the games use today.

evidence.semantic-correctness: 21/26: dynamic-dependency skip impossible, write-during-memo silent, NaN refires, revert-fires (artifacts/conformance-imperative.json)
evidence.update-cost: sparse-update p50 0.0170ms = O(all live derivations) per write; 28x custom with only 200 memos
evidence.public-api-fit: contract accepted but use() tracking is a no-op; UI-RUNTIME-001 scaling requirement unmet

consequences: Public API unchanged (contract holds). Fusion stays vendored for reference; the adapter and baseline remain as conformance foils and rubric evidence. UI-RUNTIME-001's no-rerun guarantee at scale requires O(affected) updates, which only the custom core provides with queryable diagnostics.
